Downtown homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Downtown, September 2026. No detached houses were listed or sold in Downtown between June and September. Condos and townhomes: 102 listed at month end and 15 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Condos and townhomes: 50 sold over 4 months against an average of 104.5 listed, about 8.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 16 sold.

New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: What sold in Downtown New Westminster in September 2026?
faq.a: Condos & townhomes: 15 solds from 102 listings, a 15% sales ratio; there was no detached stock listed. At the New Westminster community level the condos & townhomes median sale price was $560,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Is Downtown the same as the Quay?
faq.a: No — on the board taxonomy they are separate sub-areas: Downtown is the Columbia Street core above the waterfront, and the Quay is the Quayside Drive waterfront pocket (researched separately). The City's OCP neighbourhoods map, by contrast, names one area "Downtown (including Quayside)".

faq.q: Which SkyTrain stations and buses serve Downtown?
faq.a: New Westminster Station and Columbia Station, both on the Expo Line, are in Downtown; TransLink routes listed for New Westminster Station include 102, 103, 105, 106, 109, 112 and 123.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Downtown address?
faq.a: For the sample address 85 Merivale Street, the SD40 locator result recorded in the master research is École Qayqayt Elementary, Fraser River Middle and New Westminster Secondary; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the locator.

faq.q: Is Downtown in the Fraser River floodplain?
faq.a: The waterfront is — the City's floodplain study puts the Downtown waterfront in Floodplain Zone 3, where many newer buildings have floor space above the Flood Construction Level but egress and the waterfront path sit below it; confirm the specific building's compliance and insurance.
